questions.title: Exact replication and audit of the published PyMLE CIR example
questions.description: Conduct an L1 exact published-source replication of the CIR simulation and maximum-likelihood example accompanying Kirkby, Nguyen, Nguyen, and Nguyen, Journal of Statistical Software 113(4), 2025. Use only the operator-supplied hash-bound repository snapshot and operator-pinned execution. Inspect the paper/repository context, README, unchanged Example_CIR_MLE.py entrypoint, relevant CIR/simulator/density/optimizer source, package metadata, published requirements, license, and independent environment lock. Run the pinned source without editing, wrapping, replacing, or supplying model-authored arguments. In one durable Markdown report, record the paper, repository commit, snapshot, entrypoint, no-argument command, interpreter and package environment, simulation design, optimizer bounds and initial guess, every printed estimator result, termination diagnostics, stderr warnings, and the relationship between repeated-run numerical values and variable timing text. Audit any misleading source comment or compatibility discrepancy you observe. Interpret the fixed-seed estimates only to the extent justified by one simulated path. Distinguish this exact example rerun from reproduction of a paper table or figure, validation of every PyMLE model or approximation, a Monte Carlo performance study, confirmatory empirical evidence, an estimator-ranking theorem, or formal proof. No model-authored estimator, replacement simulation, novelty claim, or Lean formalization is required. Disclose all remaining source, environment, optimizer, interpretation, and scientific-scope gaps honestly.
